pre_declared_validation_gate.clause_2_validation_rmse: delta_RMSE_val <= +0.050 mm (formalized in Round 13 after Round 12 raw_nan finding)
pre_declared_validation_gate.clause_3_validation_p90_tail_mae: delta_P90_Tail_MAE_val <= +0.250 mm on days >= 11.086 mm (formalized in Round 13)
pre_declared_validation_gate.tie_breaker_rule: Minimize max_m |delta_MAE_val|; prefer stateless P-c if difference <= 0.005 mm

P-0_COMPLETE_ALL_35.notes: Requires all 35 variables (24 Meteo + 3 FlashFlux + 8 CERES SYN1deg); 0 true future days.

P-a_P-b_FLASHFLUX_27VARS.notes: Eliminates CERES-8 only; 0 true future days whenever FlashFlux lag >= 7 days or interior dropouts occur (e.g., 2026-11-06).

P-c_DOY_MEDIAN_ALL_11_SOLAR.notes: Anchor constrained only by 24 Meteorology vars; unlocks 3 to 5 true future days (is_prospective=1) and stateless DOY lookup.

P-c-ffill7_LE7D_PLUS_DOY_CERES8.notes: Anchor constrained by 24 Meteo vars (FlashFlux ffill when lag<=7d + DOY CERES-8); same 3 to 5 true future days as P-c.

selection_reason: Both P-c and passing candidate(s) fall within <= 0.005 mm sampling noise on max|delta_MAE_val|; selected P-c (DOY_MEDIAN_ALL_11_SOLAR) by Occam's razor because it is stateless and anchor-DOY deterministic.
